purpose: Pre-backtest research queue for the first formal WorldQuant alpha cycle.
selection_principles: Prefer interpretable data families over operator soup.
Use one primary direction plus distinct backup lanes.
Reward expected submission value per research hour, not raw novelty alone.
Keep crowded price-only control lines in the queue only as controls.

official_verification_boundary.reason: WorldQuant Learn documentation redirected to sign-in in this session, so current submission thresholds and account-specific field visibility still require manual platform confirmation.
implications: Do not treat current Sharpe or Fitness thresholds as officially verified from this session.
Do not treat any candidate field below as confirmed on the current account until Data Explorer shows it.
Use this queue for prioritization, not as proof of live submission readiness.

items.name: analyst_eps_price_industry
items.notes: 第一正式主攻线。逻辑最清楚，baseline 明确，可直接从 est_eps/close 的行业内排序切入，并且自然长出 20/60/120 窗口和相邻 analyst 字段分支。
items.next_step: Search eps and analyst fields in Data Explorer, confirm est_eps visibility, then simulate 20/60/120-window baseline variants.

items.name: event_option_volume_gate
items.notes: 低相关备线优先级很高，但执行摩擦更大。先作为第二条线保留，避免第一正式 cycle 一开始就把时间花在 coverage 和事件稀疏性上。
items.next_step: Check whether option sentiment fields such as pcr_oi_all are visible, then run one minimal trade_when baseline before any extra gating.

items.name: sentiment_buzz_stability
items.notes: 适合作为 analyst 线后的第三优先级。它能训练快信号降 turnover，但不该在第一枪前抢走注意力。
items.next_step: Search sentiment1 buzz-style fields and compare 5/10/20-day stability windows with and without smoothing.

items.name: sales_delta_fundamental
items.notes: 慢信号后备线。相比静态基本面更像变化率信号，适合在 analyst 和 sentiment 之后补一条更慢、更稳的家族。
items.next_step: Run ts_delta(sales, 21/63/126) baselines and compare raw versus ranked variants once the first faster lanes are underway.

items.name: operating_income_history_position
items.notes: 保留为慢信号基线和对照组，适合在需要更稳解释框架时再开跑。
items.next_step: Check operating income field coverage first, then compare ts_rank windows before adding group treatment.

items.name: capital_structure_ratio
items.notes: 结构简单、解释性强，但首轮 expected reward per hour 不如 analyst / sentiment / event 线。
items.next_step: Run liabilities/assets baseline only after higher-priority lines have first-pass results.

items.name: sales_acceleration
items.notes: 这是 sales_delta 的进阶分支，不适合抢在一阶变化率前面。
items.next_step: Only revisit after sales_delta_fundamental shows stable promise; compare first versus second differences directly.

items.name: smoothed_mean_reversion_control
items.notes: 保留为快反馈控制组，不作为正式主攻线，也不允许它挤掉 analyst / event / sentiment 研究时间。
items.next_step: Keep as a control batch only; do not promote it unless every fresher lane is blocked.
